title: Harissa chicken grain bowl
ingredients: 200g cooked freekeh or brown rice (100g dry)
Small handful parsley, chopped + pinch salt & pepper
steps: Toss chicken in harissa + 1 tsp oil + salt. Sear 6-7 min until charred and cooked through.
Warm grains & chickpeas with pinch cumin, 1 tsp oil, lemon zest.
Build bowl: grains base, chicken, cucumber, tomatoes, feta, parsley.
Drizzle lemon juice + remaining oil. Pack feta separately if prepping.
storage: Fridge 3 days. Keep grains and chicken separate from fresh veg. Add feta day-of.

title: High-protein tuna wrap no mayo
ingredients: 2 x 145g cans tuna in water, drained well (total 290g drained ~180g)
steps: Mix tuna, yogurt, Dijon, capers, lemon, pepper — no mayo needed.
Warm wraps 10 sec. Spread tuna mix, top with carrots, cucumber, leaves.
Roll tight, slice diagonally. Secure with parchment for lunchbox.
storage: Filling keeps 2 days chilled. Assemble wrap morning-of to avoid soggy.

title: Rotisserie chicken quinoa crunch salad
steps: Whisk yogurt, vinegar, honey, salt & pepper for quick dressing.
Toss quinoa, chicken, apple, celery, half almonds with dressing.
Finish with rocket and remaining almonds for crunch.
storage: Best within 24h. Keep rocket separate; add just before eating.

title: White bean tuna salad
ingredients: 1 x 400g can cannellini beans, drained & rinsed (240g)
steps: Rinse onion in cold water 1 min to mellow, then drain.
Gently combine beans, tuna flakes, tomatoes, cucumber, onion, olives.
Dress with EVOO, lemon, parsley. Rest 10 min for beans to absorb.
storage: Fridge 3 days — actually improves. No heating needed. Dubai-proof.

title: Pesto chicken salad with crackers
ingredients: 30g sun-dried tomatoes in oil, drained & sliced
steps: Stir pesto + yogurt. Fold in chicken, celery, sun-dried tomatoes, lemon.
Pack spinach separate. Serve salad scooped with crackers or over spinach.
Add pepper, extra lemon to taste — no extra salt needed.
storage: Fridge 3 days. Keep crackers in separate pouch to stay crisp.

title: Mediterranean chickpea bowl
ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil + 1.5 tbsp lemon juice
1 tsp cumin, pinch paprika, mint leaves
steps: Cook couscous with pinch salt, fluff. Toss chickpeas warm with cumin, 1 tbsp oil.
Mix veg, olives, mint. Whisk lemon + remaining oil for dressing.
Bowl up: couscous, chickpeas, salad, feta crumbled on top.
storage: Fridge 4 days. Plant-powered — holds best of the week. Good cold.

title: Chicken tikka bagel
ingredients: 80g 0% Greek yogurt + 1 tbsp tikka paste + 1 tsp lemon
40g mint yogurt chutney (yogurt + mint + pinch salt)
steps: Marinate chicken 15 min (or overnight) in yogurt + tikka + lemon. Grill/pan 7-8 min.
Toast bagels. Spread mint chutney on both sides.
Layer lettuce, chicken, onion, cucumber. Close and wrap in foil.
storage: Chicken keeps 3 days. Assemble bagel morning-of or toast base only.

title: Salmon avocado rice bowl
ingredients: 200g cooked sushi or jasmine rice (100g dry)
1 tsp sesame oil + 1 tbsp sesame seeds
steps: Pan-sear salmon 3-4 min in 1 tsp oil, glaze with 1 tbsp soy + lime. Rest.
Warm rice with sesame oil. Add edamame, cucumber.
Top with salmon, avocado, sesame seeds, ginger. Extra soy on side.
storage: Fridge 2 days max for salmon. Keep avocado & dress separately with lime.

title: Turkey hummus veggie wrap
ingredients: 200g sliced roast turkey breast (deli, low sodium)
steps: Spread hummus on wraps. Layer turkey, peppers, cucumber, carrots, spinach.
Crumble feta, squeeze lemon, roll tightly.
Slice in half — holds well for grab-and-go.
storage: Wrap best day-of. Hummus base prevents soggy — still good next day wrapped.

title: Chicken Waldorf toast
steps: Mix yogurt, Dijon, lemon, pepper. Toss chicken, apple, celery, half walnuts.
Toast sourdough. Top with leaves, then Waldorf chicken salad.
Finish with remaining walnuts and drizzle honey if liked.
storage: Salad keeps 2 days. Toast bread fresh — pack components separately.

title: Lemony lentil soup + side salad
ingredients: Side: 80g cucumber, 80g tomatoes, 20g parsley, 1 tbsp olive oil, lemon
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, garlic in 1 tbsp oil 4 min. Add spices, lentils, stock. Simmer 18 min.
Blend half for creaminess, stir lemon juice + zest + remaining oil.
Toss quick side salad — serve with soup, warm or room temp.
storage: Soup keeps 4 days, freezes well. Side salad day-of.

title: Tuna olive cucumber sandwich
steps: Mix tuna, yogurt, capers, olives, Dijon, lemon.
Layer rocket, tuna mix, cucumber on bread. Top slice.
Press lightly, slice. Pack with ice pack if commuting.
storage: Filling 2 days. Assemble morning-of for crisp cucumber.

title: Grilled shrimp power bowl
ingredients: 1 tsp smoked paprika + pinch garlic powder
steps: Toss shrimp with paprika, oil, salt. Sear 2-3 min per side until pink.
Char corn in same pan 2 min. Warm quinoa & beans with lime.
Bowl up everything, finish with avocado, tomato, cilantro, feta.
storage: Fridge 2 days (shrimp). Keep avocado with lime, separate.

title: Egg white bean skillet
steps: Sauté garlic in oil 1 min, add tomatoes, beans, spinach — wilt 2 min.
Pour eggs, scramble softly 2-3 min. Season with za’atar, chilli.
Top with feta. Serve warm or room temp with lemon wedge.
storage: Fridge 3 days. Reheats well — great for Sunday prep into Mon.

title: Spiced chickpea & quinoa power bowl
ingredients: 1 tsp cumin + 1 tsp smoked paprika + 1/2 tsp turmeric
steps: Toss chickpeas in cumin, paprika, turmeric + 1 tsp oil + salt. Pan-fry 5-6 min until crispy.
Warm quinoa with a splash of water and remaining oil.
Whisk tahini + lemon juice + 2 tbsp water + pinch salt into a dressing.
Build bowl: quinoa, spinach, tomatoes, cucumber, crispy chickpeas. Drizzle dressing.
storage: Fridge 3 days. Keep dressing separate. Chickpeas lose crunch — re-crisp in a dry pan.

title: Crispy tofu & mango rice paper rolls
ingredients: 1 tbsp soy sauce + 1 tsp sesame oil
2 tbsp peanut butter + 1 tbsp soy sauce + 1/2 lime, juice + 1 tsp chilli flakes
steps: Marinate tofu in soy + sesame oil 5 min. Pan-fry on high 7-8 min until golden all sides.
Whisk peanut butter, soy, lime juice, chilli + 2 tbsp water into dipping sauce.
Soften rice paper in warm water 20 sec. Fill with noodles, tofu, mango, carrot, cucumber, herbs. Roll tight.
Serve rolls with peanut dipping sauce.
storage: Fridge 1 day — wrap each roll in damp paper towel. Sauce fridge 4 days.

title: Lentil & roasted red pepper wrap
steps: Warm lentils in a pan with oil, cumin, paprika, salt + splash of water 3-4 min.
Quick-pickle red onion in vinegar + pinch salt for 5 min.
Spread hummus on wrap. Layer lentils, roasted peppers, pickled onion, rocket.
Fold sides in and roll tight. Slice on the diagonal.
storage: Fridge 2 days — wrap in foil. Pack rocket separately to avoid wilting.

title: Edamame & avocado sushi bowl
ingredients: 2 tbsp soy sauce + 1 tsp sesame oil + 1 tsp rice vinegar
steps: Season cooked rice with rice vinegar + pinch salt. Fan to cool slightly.
Mix soy sauce + sesame oil into a dressing.
Build bowl: rice base, edamame, avocado, cucumber, carrot, nori strips.
Drizzle dressing, scatter sesame seeds + pickled ginger.
storage: Fridge 1 day — avocado browns. Add avocado fresh. Rice keeps 2 days.

title: Black bean & corn burrito bowl
ingredients: 1 tsp cumin + 1 tsp smoked paprika + 1/2 tsp chilli powder
steps: Fry beans + corn in oil with cumin, paprika, chilli 4-5 min. Add lime juice.
Season cabbage with pinch salt + a few drops lime juice.
Build bowl: rice, spiced beans, cabbage, tomatoes, salsa, coriander.
Finish with remaining lime juice.
storage: Fridge 3 days. Keep cabbage and tomatoes separate for best texture.

title: Peanut noodles with crispy tofu
ingredients: 3 tbsp peanut butter + 1 tbsp soy sauce + 1 tbsp rice vinegar + 1 tsp sesame oil + 1 tsp chilli paste
steps: Press tofu dry. Pan-fry in oil over high heat 7-8 min until golden. Add 1 tbsp soy in last minute.
Whisk peanut butter, soy, rice vinegar, sesame oil, chilli paste + 3 tbsp warm water.
Toss warm noodles with peanut sauce, red pepper, carrot, half the spring onions.
Top with crispy tofu, sesame seeds, remaining spring onions + lime juice.
storage: Fridge 2 days. Noodles absorb sauce — add splash of water when reheating.

title: Smoky red lentil soup & flatbread
ingredients: 1 tsp cumin + 1 tsp smoked paprika + 1/4 tsp cayenne
steps: Soften onion in oil 5 min. Add garlic + spices 1 min.
Add lentils, tomatoes, stock. Simmer 18-20 min until lentils are soft.
Blend half the soup for a creamy-chunky texture. Season with lemon juice + salt.
Warm flatbreads. Serve soup topped with parsley + drizzle of oil.
storage: Fridge 4 days. Thickens overnight — thin with a little water when reheating.

title: Falafel hummus grain plate
steps: Heat falafel per packet — oven 10 min at 180 °C or pan-fry 3-4 min.
Season grains with lemon juice + 1 tbsp oil + pinch salt.
Spread hummus on plate. Pile grains alongside tomato-cucumber-onion salad.
Top with falafel, drizzle remaining oil, sprinkle za'atar + parsley.
storage: Fridge 2 days. Reheat falafel in a dry pan to crisp up. Keep salad separate.

title: Teriyaki tempeh & broccoli rice bowl
ingredients: 3 tbsp soy sauce + 1 tbsp maple syrup + 1 tsp sesame oil + 1 tsp rice vinegar + 1 garlic clove, grated
steps: Mix soy, maple syrup, sesame oil, rice vinegar, garlic, ginger into teriyaki sauce.
Pan-fry tempeh in oil 3-4 min each side until golden. Pour over sauce, cook 2 min until glazed.
Steam or stir-fry broccoli 4-5 min until bright green and tender-crisp.
Bowl: rice, broccoli, teriyaki tempeh. Scatter sesame seeds + spring onions.
storage: Fridge 3 days. Sauce intensifies — reheat tempeh with a splash of water.

title: Quinoa tabbouleh with roasted chickpeas
ingredients: Large handful flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped
steps: Toss chickpeas in cumin, paprika + 1 tsp oil + salt. Roast 200 °C for 15 min or pan-fry until crispy.
Cool quinoa to room temp. Combine with parsley, mint, tomatoes, cucumber, spring onions.
Dress with lemon juice + olive oil + salt + pepper. Toss well.
Top with crispy chickpeas just before serving.
storage: Fridge 3 days — improves overnight. Add chickpeas day-of to keep crunch.

title: Thai-style peanut tofu with jasmine rice
ingredients: 100g mange tout or sugar snap peas
3 tbsp peanut butter + 2 tbsp soy sauce + 1 tbsp lime juice + 1 tsp chilli flakes + 1 tsp brown sugar
Fresh coriander + lime wedge to serve
steps: Pan-fry tofu in oil over high heat 6-7 min until golden. Set aside.
Fry garlic + ginger 30 sec. Add peppers + mange tout 3 min.
Stir in peanut butter, soy, lime, chilli, sugar + 4 tbsp water into a sauce. Add tofu back, toss 1 min.
Serve over rice. Top with coriander + lime wedge.
storage: Fridge 2 days. Sauce thickens — loosen with water when reheating.

title: Smoky chipotle bean tacos
ingredients: 240g kidney or black beans, drained & rinsed
1 tsp chipotle paste + 1 tsp cumin + 1/2 tsp smoked paprika
steps: Fry beans in oil with chipotle paste, cumin, paprika + 2 tbsp water 4-5 min. Lightly mash.
Toss cabbage with lime juice + pinch salt.
Warm tortillas dry in a hot pan 30 sec each side.
Fill tortillas: beans, cabbage, tomato, avocado, salsa, coriander.
storage: Fridge 2 days — beans only. Assemble tacos fresh. Avocado add day-of.

title: Greek-style stuffed bell peppers
steps: Preheat oven 200 °C. Place pepper halves cut-side up on a baking tray. Brush with oil + salt.
Mix rice, chickpeas, tomatoes, onion, tomato paste, oregano, cumin, lemon juice + 1 tbsp oil.
Fill peppers generously with rice mixture. Roast 20-22 min until peppers are tender.
Finish with parsley + extra lemon juice.
storage: Fridge 3 days. Reheat covered at 180 °C for 10 min or microwave 2 min.

title: Green lentil & spinach coconut curry
ingredients: 2 tsp curry powder + 1/2 tsp turmeric + 1/2 tsp cumin
steps: Soften onion in coconut oil 5 min. Add garlic, ginger + spices 1 min.
Add lentils, coconut milk, stock. Simmer 20-22 min until lentils are tender.
Stir in spinach until wilted. Season with lime juice + salt.
Serve over rice.
storage: Fridge 4 days. Thickens — add coconut milk or water when reheating.

title: Scrambled eggs & smoked salmon on sourdough
steps: Melt butter in a non-stick pan over low heat. Beat eggs with a pinch of salt.
Add eggs and stir slowly with a spatula — pull from edges inward — remove from heat while still slightly wet.
Pile onto toast, lay smoked salmon over, scatter capers and grind over black pepper.
storage: Best eaten fresh. Scrambled eggs don't reheat well.

title: Greek yogurt parfait with granola & berries
steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl.
Top with granola, then scatter berries over.
Drizzle with honey and serve immediately.
storage: Layer without granola and refrigerate up to 1 day — add granola just before eating.

title: Poached eggs on avocado & feta toast
steps: Bring a small pan of water to a gentle simmer. Add a splash of vinegar. Crack each egg into a cup and slide in — poach 3 min.
Mash avocado on toast with lemon, salt and pepper. Crumble feta over.
Lift eggs out with a slotted spoon, rest on a cloth 10 sec, then place on top.
storage: Prep avocado just before eating; poached eggs can be held in cold water and reheated 1 min.

title: Overnight oats with berries & almonds
steps: The night before: stir oats and milk together in a jar or bowl. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
In the morning: top with berries, almonds and honey. Eat straight from the jar.
storage: Keeps refrigerated 3 days without toppings.

title: Spinach & feta omelette
steps: Beat eggs with salt and pepper. Heat oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add spinach, stir 30 sec until just wilted. Pour eggs over and cook undisturbed 2 min.
Scatter feta over half, fold omelette, slide onto plate.
storage: Best eaten fresh.

title: Turkey & egg open sandwich
steps: Toast bread and spread with Dijon. Layer rocket and turkey slices on top.
Fry or poach eggs to your liking, season well.
Place eggs on top of turkey. Eat open-faced.
storage: Assemble just before eating.

title: Halloumi & tomato skillet
steps: Heat a dry non-stick pan over medium-high. Sear halloumi 2 min each side until golden.
Push halloumi aside. Add tomatoes cut-side down and cook 3 min until softened.
Plate with toast. Season generously with pepper and oregano.
storage: Halloumi is best fresh; can be reheated in a dry pan.

title: Cheddar & egg scramble on toast
ingredients: Salt & black pepper, fresh chives to finish
steps: Melt butter over low heat. Beat eggs with salt and pepper, pour in.
Stir slowly until just set, remove from heat and fold in cheddar — residual heat melts it.
Pile onto toast, top with chives.
storage: Best eaten immediately.

title: Chia pudding with berries & almonds
steps: The night before: whisk chia seeds, almond milk and honey together. Refrigerate overnight.
In the morning: stir well (chia can settle), top with berries and almonds.
storage: Base keeps refrigerated 4 days without toppings.

title: Smoked salmon & avocado bagel
steps: Toast bagel halves.
Layer avocado slices on each half, then smoked salmon.
Scatter capers and red onion over. Finish with lemon and pepper.
storage: Assemble just before eating.

title: Greek yogurt bowl with walnuts, honey & banana
steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl.
Arrange banana slices on top, scatter walnuts.
Drizzle with honey.
storage: Prep without banana — slice just before eating to avoid browning.

title: Soft-boiled eggs on whole-grain toast with Dijon
steps: Lower eggs into boiling water. Cook exactly 6½ min, then into cold water 1 min.
Toast bread, spread with butter and Dijon.
Peel eggs, halve over toast and season.
storage: Soft-boiled eggs keep (unpeeled) in the fridge 2 days.

title: Bell pepper & feta omelette
ingredients: ½ red bell pepper, finely diced
steps: Heat oil in a non-stick pan over medium. Sauté pepper 3 min until softened.
Beat eggs with seasoning. Pour over pepper, cook undisturbed 2 min.
Scatter feta over half, fold and slide onto plate.
storage: Best eaten fresh.

title: Poached eggs on wilted spinach & sourdough
ingredients: Salt & black pepper, pinch of nutmeg
steps: Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Add spinach and toss until wilted, about 2 min. Season with salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Poach eggs: simmer water, add a splash of vinegar, slide eggs in and cook 3 min.
Pile spinach on toast, top with eggs, squeeze lemon over.
storage: Best eaten fresh. Wilted spinach keeps 1 day refrigerated.
